title: Triangle Center / Focus Field
claim: Tests whether a continuous three-axis intent lens plus discrete lawful constraints improves selection among concrete CURRENT/QUEUE next moves without replacing CURRENT as authority.

primary_source.projection: exact next-action instructions; large archive excluded by default

geometry.position: INTENT or SYSTEM profile; deterministic heuristic only
geometry.mass: CURRENT authority/readiness weight or federation experimental FCM mass
geometry.pins: maximum three local candidate moves; no queue mutation

applied_integrations: CURRENT is default source; FEDERATION is secondary
CURRENT next-action adapter preserves exact CURRENT/QUEUE text
CURRENT-vs-QUEUE next-direction contradiction is displayed rather than auto-resolved
FieldSignals candidate/accepted/overridden events are emitted during ordinary CURRENT use
focused CURRENT action can preload HUMAN PORT through same-origin sessionStorage
OPEN remains explicit and uses a bounded route adapter
BACK, RETURN and PIN remain distinct
same-instrument CENTER vs PLAIN CURRENT/QUEUE reading comparator
PLAIN preserves exact source order while sharing the same constraints, focus, OPEN/PIN/PORT/RETURN actions
passive FieldSignals evidence records which reading proposed the selected move
authority_boundary: CENTER proposes/focuses only. It does not mutate CURRENT, QUEUE, repository state, external communication, House actuation or purchases.
evolution_gate: CLOSED. No further ordinary-use gate is required for CENTER itself. Future work requires an explicit named dependency from a current head.
known_limits: The simplex profiles are deterministic heuristics, not ground truth.
CURRENT action adapter must be refreshed when CURRENT/QUEUE semantics materially change; live root loading is preferred.
HUMAN PORT preload creates no send authority.
No comparative usability win has been demonstrated.
CENTER is no longer an active selector; its presence is archival/donor and comparative.
verification: inline JavaScript syntax passed after CURRENT integration
14 concrete CURRENT/QUEUE next actions recovered at implementation time
CURRENT and FEDERATION source toggle present
HUMAN PORT handoff producer and consumer both present
CENTER/PLAIN comparator syntax and source-order path verified

disposition.reason: PLAIN/FCM absorbed the useful control-surface direction; CENTER remains useful as a preserved comparison fixture and geometry donor, not a live front.
disposition.reopen_only_if: a named current head has a missing selection function that cannot be expressed without this geometry
